name: Liquid flow switch
summary: A liquid-flow switch issues a contact state when a documented flow condition actuates it.
description: A liquid-flow switch issues a contact state when a documented flow condition actuates it. It is used in cooling or auxiliary systems where flow confirmation participates in permissives or alarms.
readingNotes: Identify whether the contact indicates sufficient flow or loss of flow.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A flow switch gives a discrete condition; a flow transmitter gives a measured signal.
